name: Insect War
desc:
🐜 INSECT WAR
Build your COLONY, grow your EMPIRE, and command your SWARMS to DOMINATE!

⭐ HOW TO PLAY: • Claim land and build your colony • Farm resources and sell them for cash • Expand nests to grow your population • Research upgrades to get stronger • Raise insect swarms and conquer the map

💡 PLAY YOUR WAY: • Stack farms and become filthy rich • Build a terrifying military empire • Or balance both and take over everything

Your colony keeps working even while you’re away - come back bigger every time.

Start tiny. Grow huge. Rule the dirt.

👍 Enjoying the game? Leave a thumbs up!
